title: Big Little
body: Every new member is paired with an older member for mentorship, advice, and a built-in best friend. Big-little lineages span many generations of DSS.
imageAlt: A DSS Big and Little smiling together at a Big–Little reveal

title: House System
body: Members are sorted into one of DSS's Houses and compete all year for the House Cup at socials, trivia nights, and more.
imageAlt: DSS members repping their House colors at a competition

title: Chummings
body: We sort the club into small groups for chill weekly hangouts to meet all members within the club.
imageAlt: A small DSS chumming group hanging out over coffee

title: Retreats
body: Each semester the club heads off-campus for an exciting weekend retreat packed with games, bonding, and nature.
imageAlt: DSS members bonding outdoors on a weekend retreat

title: Socials
body: From climbing nights at Mosaic to San Francisco scavenger hunts to House Olympics, socials are how we celebrate our hard work.
imageAlt: DSS members celebrating together at a club social
